newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks pare gains in line with Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks pare gains in line with Wall Street.

text.p: The Mexican bourse reined in early gains in early afternoon trade Friday after a morning rally on Wall Street faded, dealers said.
"It's really dull...it started well, but then went off the boil when the Dow Jones turned around," a floor trader said. "But I think it will pick up in a while, it looks firm and they are buying."
The leading IPC share index was up 13.69 points, or 0.36 percent, at 3,835.61. The Dow Jones was meanwhile up 15.66 points at 7152.28.
Trading volume was moderate at 44.1 million shares.
